description: This line plot illustrates the relative change in performance across different layers of the Mistral-7B-v0.2-Instruct model following Layer-Wise Quantized Pruning with SnapKV, under a KV cache budget of 1/64. The x-axis represents the model layers, categorized as "Layer1-4", "Layer5-12", "Layer13-20", "Layer21-28", and "Layer29-32", with no numerical scale or units indicated. The y-axis represents "Relative Change" in percentage, ranging from -15% to 5%, with tick marks at intervals of 5%. The plot contains five distinct lines: a dashed orange line for "LB-Avg of 2×tokens,8-bit" starting at approximately 0% and ending near 0%; a dashed red line for "LB-Avg of 1×tokens,16-bit" starting near 0% and ending near 0%; a dashed cyan line for "RULER4k of 2×tokens,8-bit" starting near 0%, dipping to approximately -10% at "Layer13-20", and rising to approximately 0% at "Layer29-32"; a dashed dark blue line for "RULER4k of 1×tokens,16-bit" starting near 0%, dipping to approximately -15% at "Layer13-20", and rising to approximately 0% at "Layer29-32"; and a dashed gray line for "Baseline of 4×tokens,4-bit" that remains relatively flat near 0% across all layers.
